chapter.title: Debugging support
chapter.para: These requirements apply to the parts of JetOS that are there to debug and to monitor a module. The GDB server, the monitor and the instrumentation are present only in a kernel that is built with them.

section.title: SRQ_JET_DBG_001
section.para: JetOS shall, when it is built with the GDB server, accept requests of the GDB remote serial protocol over the debug console, with checksums and acknowledgments, in the time slots of the schedule that are GDB slots and, if it is configured to wait for GDB, at the start of the module before the partitions start.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A debugger can be connected to a module that is running in a defined way.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_DBG_002
section.para: JetOS shall present to the debugger the kernel as process 1, whose threads are the kernel-only partitions, and each user partition as a process of its own, whose threads are the processes of the partition and an idle thread for the time when no process can run.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The debugger sees the module as ARINC 653 partitions and processes.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_DBG_003
section.para: JetOS shall stop the whole module while the debugger holds it, and shall not count the time spent stopped in the system time.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Time slots, deadlines and time-outs of the partitions must not be affected by debugging.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_DBG_004
section.para: JetOS shall let the debugger read and write the registers of a thread, including those of the floating point unit, and read and write the memory of the space of a thread (or of the kernel) as far as it can be accessed, showing the debugger the code that is in memory under a breakpoint and keeping the breakpoints when the debugger writes the code.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A debugger shows and changes the state of the module.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_DBG_005
section.para: JetOS shall let the debugger set and clear software breakpoints, and hardware breakpoints and watchpoints (as far as the processor supports their kind and size), and shall stop the module and report the reason when one is hit.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: These are the means of a debugger to stop the program at a point or at an access.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_DBG_006
section.para: JetOS shall let the debugger resume the module, run it one instruction at a time, change the program counter and interrupt a running module in a GDB slot.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: These are the controls of a debugger.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_DBG_007
section.para: JetOS shall let the debugger attach to and detach from the processes, and shall end the session, with all the breakpoints and watchpoints removed, when the debugger detaches from the last one.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A module must not keep breakpoints that nobody uses.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_DBG_008
section.para: JetOS shall, when it is built with the monitor, read commands on the main console after a character has been typed, with the partitions paused, and offer the commands that list the partitions, give the state of a partition, pause, resume and restart it, reset the module, leave the monitor and show help; and shall resume the partitions that are not kept paused when the monitor is left.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: An operator can examine and control a module on a terminal.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_DBG_009
section.para: JetOS shall let the monitor read a line with editing, a prompt and the history of the lines typed.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Commands are typed by a person.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_DBG_010
section.para: JetOS shall, when it is built with instrumentation, print on the console the description of the partitions and of the processes and the events of the running process in the format of the Cheddar scheduling tool.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A schedule can be analysed offline.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_DBG_011
section.para: JetOS shall provide a fatal stop of the kernel that prints a message and halts the module, and that can be used at any point of the kernel, also in a kernel thread with preemption enabled.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Errors that cannot be recovered must be reported, and the module must not go on.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_DBG_012
section.para: JetOS shall provide a dump of memory on the console, in hexadecimal with the printable characters, as a diagnostic.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The state of memory has to be seen when debugging.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.
